usage: tr split register [-h] --cutoff CUTOFF --embargo EMBARGO
                         [--prereg-json FILE] [--note NOTE]

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
  --cutoff CUTOFF     first test session, YYYY-MM-DD (a future NYSE session)
  --embargo EMBARGO   sessions left out before the cutoff (>= 20)
  --prereg-json FILE  Prereg fields as JSON, without registered_at (default:
                      the TRAINING-SPIKE §7.3 gate)
  --note NOTE         the hypothesis the Prereg tests
